program.section_heading: Graphic Design and Digital Media - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS950/AS950B/AS950C/CE950
outcomes: Demonstrate graphic design and layout principles consistent with the principles and elements of design.
Analyze and explain methods and techniques to design aesthetically pleasing and effective typographiccommunication.
Utilize various digital image-editing tools to edit, retouch, manipulate, enhance, optimize and compositeraster-based images for a broad range of graphic design and digital media usages.
Understand the technical differences and advantages of raster-based and vector-based images forvarious design outputs and digital applications.
Understand the unique challenges of creating rich content for today’s digital, mobile and cross-platformdesign environment.
Create effective motion graphics designs and multimedia animations for various marketing, advertisingand promotional narratives.
Demonstrate solid understanding in today’s modern web technology, website structure and theimportance of user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) in the context of digital design.
Utilize various web design and web development tools effectively in order to create digital content for awide range of online distribution, promotion and e-commerce.
Understand the technical differences and advantages of various digital, video and audio file formats inthe context of graphic design and digital media.

notes: The section covers both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the program requirements and Program Learning Outcomes are printed once and shared by both awards, so they are recorded here for the A.S. Degree.

Electives (Units: 3.00): 'Select 3 units from one emphasis.' Each emphasis is recorded as its own choose_units block (3 units) in option group 'Electives emphasis'; within each emphasis the two courses are joined by OR, so effectively one 3-unit course is chosen.
Total of 37.00 units is printed for the major (34 required + 3 elective); general education is required but no GE pattern is named in the text.

Catalog prints ADM-63A as 'Design For Print Publication' while the state file titles ADM 63A 'Adobe InDesign, Beginning'; titles for ADM-71B and ADM-77A/77B also differ slightly. Codes match; reviewer may verify.
ADM-62, ADM-63B and ADM-66 appear in the catalog but not in the closed list; recorded as catalog additions.
Several outcomes are printed with words run together (e.g., 'typographiccommunication', 'compositeraster-based'); copied exactly as printed.
The text begins with a fragment of a preceding program heading ('nt - AS950/AS950C/CE950'), which was ignored.
